supplement.recommendation: Reuse this exact middle petal through UV cropping on a new small curved mesh. Add only one or two per visible authored node to chapters without isolated source effects; do not move large background paintings. The raw bitmap remains untouched.

limitations: This audit checks visual eligibility, not final camera visibility or timing; the integration must verify each authored node in the browser.
Source-authored animation is preserved separately, including any original composite motion; the approved list only controls new additive environment animation.
Candidate safeIndependentName is heuristic and not trusted; several such entries were rejected after actual image inspection.
